sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Debrief completed; gearing up before heading out on patrol.
Heading out on patrol to check in on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks on Queen Street at Localito, McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Elliott Street and Darby Street all clear; heading up to Victoria Street.
Welfare check at Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store and Amelia Cafe, all clear, no issues to report. Heading back down towards Queen Street and then towards Vulcan Lane.
Observed Council Wardens trying to wake a vagrant at the bus station. (Photo on file.) Heading to stand by for security presence.
Heading to check in on High Street.
High Street all clear; heading to check on Chancery Square.
Chancery Square and Freyberg Square all clear; standing by for security presence.

Welfare check at Fort Street, Fort Lane, Haven Mart, Right Track, Jo & Joes, 77 Convenience Store, Wilson Carpark and the White Lady, all clear. Reported to Jo & Joes about the Asian male from Thursday and updated them that the person of interest is on our watch list along with the Police. (Photo on file.) Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check at Tribe and Auckland Harbour Suites. Informed Tribe about the Asian male person of interest, as they are part of the same group as Jo & Joes. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, Coffee Club and Custom Mart, all clear, no issues to report. Heading to check on the Britomart area.
Britomart McDonald's, TK Square, Kowhai Coffee and Starbucks all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check at Woolworths Lower Albert Street; heading up Albert Street.

Arrived at Albert Mart; spoke to a worker, who was grateful for the assistance on Thursday afternoon — otherwise all clear. Standing by for security presence due to the store being a hotspot for shoplifting.
Received a call from the 77 Convenience Store at the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street; heading there now.
Before we properly arrived, the male person of interest walked past us. Staff advised the individual had left; he had been loud and disturbing the peace. Standing by for security presence.
Commencing a sweep of the Cathedral.
St Patrick's Cathedral and Square all clear; standing by for security presence.
Welfare check at Hollywood Cafe, Koffee Bar, Coffee Club, QFTAV and Chemist Warehouse, all clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading down Queen Street towards Q Convenience.
Welfare check, all clear; now heading up Queen Street:
Welfare check at Quest Hotel, Sailaway Souvenirs and New Balance; checking in on Vulcan Lane.
Vulcan Lane all clear; standing by for security presence.
Welfare check, all clear; heading to check in on Woolworths Victoria Street:
Welfare check completed at the Woolworths Victoria Street check-in, all clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading to conduct welfare checks on Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Darby Street, Elliott Street and Mid-City all clear; checking in on surrounding businesses.
Welfare check, all clear; heading to check in on Aotea Square:
Arrived at Aotea Square; welfare checked Daiso Japan and Burger Fuel before arriving. Commencing a sweep of the area.
A performance is taking place in the Aotea Square area. (Footage on file.) Otherwise the area is all clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on the Q Theatre area.
Q Theatre all clear; heading back to the office for a break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Arrived on site; standing by for the second guard to arrive.
Second guard has arrived; briefing him and gearing up.
Charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (14:45–15:00). (Photo on file.)
Response call from Albert Mart Convenience Store regarding a male individual inside the store harassing a staff member.

Arrived at the location; the staff member advised the male had already left the area. No description was given, as the staff member did not know the individual's features. Standing by outside Albert Mart for any further issues.
Currently still at Albert Mart maintaining presence (through 15:45).
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store; patrolling down Albert Street.
Albert Street all clear, no issues; patrolling lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear; arrived at Britomart due to a heavy public presence in the area and maintaining presence.
Currently still at Britomart maintaining presence.
The crowd at Britomart has cleared. Observed a male vagrant disturbing the performer; kindly asked him to move along, all clear.
Welfare check at the Downtown waterfront, all clear.
Full sweep of Britomart with welfare checks on all businesses in the area; assisting an elderly individual to lower Albert Street.
Arrived at lower Albert Street; assistance complete, all clear. Standing by at Aotea Gifts.
Welfare check at Aotea Gifts; patrolling up Albert Street.
Albert Street all clear; patrolling to Federal Street.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke Bar.
Federal Street all clear; patrolling Victoria Street West.
Full sweep of Victoria Street with a welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear; arriving at Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (17:52–19:15).
Welfare check at Darby Street, Celines and Mali Thai, all clear, no issues; patrolling Elliott Street.
Welfare check at the Elliott Wilson Carpark, The Fresh Market, Dominos, Mr Snack and the chicken, chips and fish store, all clear; arriving at Elliott Stables.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; maintaining presence before patrolling Wellesley Street.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables and its guard, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Wellesley Street.
Welfare check along Wellesley Street, all clear, no issues; patrolling Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne Street staircase mural centre, all clear, no issues identified.
Full sweep of Lorne Street with welfare checks on the remaining open businesses in the area, all clear; patrolling High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; conducting a full sweep of the area including Chancery Square.
Welfare check at Chancery Street and O'Connell Street along with the businesses in that area, all clear.
Welfare check at the Circle K store; conducting a sweep at Chancery Square.
Full sweep of Chancery Square with welfare checks on the remaining open businesses in the area, all clear.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, no issues confirmed; continuing down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane with welfare checks on businesses in the area, all clear; continuing down High Street.
The whole of High Street all clear, no issues.
Welfare check along Shortland Street and its businesses, all clear.
Welfare check, all clear, no issues:
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart with a welfare check at McDonald's. Received a call from management to head over to Headquarters; en route.
Arrived at the location; standing by assisting management with any issues.
Night Shift guard has arrived on site; standing by in the office for the second guard to arrive.
Awaiting the last Night Shift guard to arrive.
Afternoon shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Commencing Delta Route; patrolling and ensuring our presence within Queen Street.
No issues occurred during this period.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues found.
Welfare check on McDonald's Britomart and TK Square; heavy presence of members of the public and minors, no issues identified.
Welfare check on Reign N Pour, all clear.
Welfare check on Take10, all clear. Heading back and continuing patrols along Queen Street.
Arrived at Bar 101; welfare check on the static guards, all clear. Standing by to show presence.
Continuing patrols and moving on to the next checkpoint.
Response call from management reporting an issue at Bar 101, requesting our presence as soon as possible.
Welfare check on Ace Karaoke, all clear.
Arrived at Bar 101; standing by to show presence and awaiting further information from management.
Police presence now visible and on site.
Police have entered the Bar 101 premises; standing by for further updates.
Continuing patrols; Police have left the scene, no issues identified.
Standing by at Lower Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Patrolling back up Queen Street ensuring presence.
Welfare check on MotherShip, Shortland Street; standing by to show presence, all clear.
Continuing patrols along Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street, all clear.
Arrived at Bar 101; welfare checks on the static guards, all clear. Standing by for response calls while showing presence.
Making our way to HQ to commence the break.
Arrived at HQ; commencing the meal break.
Continuing to stand by for response calls while recharging the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Welfare check along Darby Street, all clear, no issues confirmed.
Heavy presence still seen outside Bar 101; maintaining presence until the crowd clears out.
Bar 101 crowd all clear, no issues; patrolling up Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Victoria Street West with welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and Skymart Convenience, all clear; patrolling through Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Street, all clear, no issues; arriving at Federal Square.
Arrived at Federal Square; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square with welfare checks of the Cathedral area and Liston House, all clear.
Top of Wyndham Street all clear; patrolling down Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Albert Street all clear, no issues.
Customs Street all clear, no issues; arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart with a welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Response call from 77 Convenience Store regarding a male individual under the influence attempting to shoplift; gearing up and heading to the location.
Arrived at the location; per the store member, the male had already left the area with stolen products, last seen walking to Albert Street.

After an extended search for the suspected individual we managed to spot him, quickly intercepted him and kindly asked him to empty his pockets; no stolen products were found. Heading back to 77 Convenience Store.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store and notified staff the individual did not have any products on him; heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone and awaiting guard handover.

flags: NOTE: Morning equipment list contained no radios.

CAPACITY: 15:12 Albert Mart harassment call — arrival 15:24 (12 minutes); team had been at HQ charging the Ops Phone.
NOTE: Night log ends at 06:06 awaiting handover — no explicit 06:30 shift-conclusion entry.
NOTE: One night guard clocked out at 04:00; remainder of the night shift ran single-guard.
NOTE: Nature of the 00:26–01:10 Bar 101 incident not stated in the log; Police attended and entered the premises.

Team at HQ charging the Ops Phone when received.
